collection.description: An old stone seat is discovered beside an inland pool.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An old stone seat is discovered beside an inland pool.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children invent a grand royal history.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (scholar), a researcher, points out that it faces a muddy bank.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The seat proves comfortable for fishing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Its shape makes sitting awkward and everyone laughs.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers preserve the curious object.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The discovery becomes a favorite destination for storytellers.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) recalls a story of an eccentric inventor.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The accounts disagree on whether the inventor was real.
